title: Board Lending Policy — Number of Operating Lines of Credit a Member May Hold
content:
A member may hold at most 3 Operating Lines of Credit products at one time.

## Policy

1. **Overall cap.** A member may hold at most 3 operating credit products at one time, counting every line in applied, active, suspended or matured status; closed and declined lines do not count.
2. **One revolving product.** Within that cap a member may hold only one revolving product — the StartRight Operating Line, the ExpressLine Operating Credit, the Revolving Operating Line, the Borrowing Base Operating Line or the Agribusiness Revolving Line. The rest of the cap can only be Seasonal Operating Loans, and no more of them may finance the same crop year than the product's allowance of Seasonal Operating Loans per crop year.
3. **A second revolving application.** A new revolving application is not registered when the member already holds a revolving product in applied, active, suspended or matured status; the member is instead offered a commitment change or a renewal of the line already held. When the existing revolving product is matured, the member is offered a renewal of it rather than a second line.
4. **Above the cap.** An application that would exceed the overall cap is not registered.

## Evidence

Whether the member already holds a revolving product is decided from the association's own records of the member's operating lines — each line's product name and status — at the time the application would be registered, never from the member's account of what they hold. Lines are matched to the applying member; a revolving line of another member does not count.

## Counting table (hypothetical holdings)

| Lines already held, by status | New application | Registered |
|---|---|---|
| One Revolving Operating Line, active | ExpressLine Operating Credit | No — a revolving product is already held; a commitment change or renewal is offered |
| One StartRight Operating Line, matured | Revolving Operating Line | No — a revolving product is already held; a renewal of the matured line is offered |
| One Revolving Operating Line, closed | Revolving Operating Line | Yes — a closed line does not count |
| One Revolving Operating Line, active; one Seasonal Operating Loan, active | Seasonal Operating Loan for a crop year the existing seasonal loan does not finance | Yes — 3 products, within the cap |
| One Revolving Operating Line, active; two Seasonal Operating Loans, active | Seasonal Operating Loan | No — a fourth product would exceed the cap |
| One ExpressLine Operating Credit, declined | Revolving Operating Line | Yes — a declined line does not count |
